title: HShattered Japanese shrimp Hot-Pot-Vessel Biryani
description: A solo-dinner dish featuring a grassy, shattering flavor profile with Cajun and tadka spices in a hot-pot-vessel setting, suitable for those no-onion-no-garlic-friendly diners.
instructions: Heat the broth in a hot-pot-vessel.
Add Cajun spice mix and tadka powder blend to the broth.
Add sliced tomatoes to the broth.
Gently add the shrimp to the broth, ensuring they are evenly distributed.
Cover the vessel and cook for 20 minutes on medium heat.
In a separate pan, toast rice as per preferred cooking instructions.
After 20 minutes, carefully transfer the rice onto the hot-pot-vessel contents using tongs or a slotted spoon to prevent spilling.
Serve hot with additional garnishes like fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
